{{Quote|This orange-skinned, four-eyed, horn-headed sentient species found themselves under attack from the government after the rise of the Galactic Empire, and many were forced to flee their homeworld.|An entry on Leffingites in an artist's journal restored and expanded by the Graf Archive|<ref name="Alien Archive" />}}
'''Leffingites''' were a horned [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] astronomical object [[Almak]]. By [[22 BBY]], the Leffingite [[speeder]] [[thief]] [[Magaloof]] worked on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] and nearly collided with the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] while joyriding. During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], many Leffginites fled Almak after the species was attacked by the government.

==Biology and appearance==
Leffingites were a bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] with [[Color|orange]] skin and two [[Limb|arms]] ending in hands with four fingers and a thumb. A Leffingite's head consisted of a wide, [[tooth]]y [[mouth]] below a broad, flat [[nose]] that ran up their face to finish between two sets of [[eye]]s, which could be brown<ref name=" Alien Archive" /> or blue.<ref name="DB" />

The higher pair of eyes was smaller and sat among the unevenly sized gray horns that emerged from the top of Leffingites' heads. The species had two long, flat [[ear]]s that protruded from just below the horns on each side of the head.<ref name=" Alien Archive" /> The species was capable of speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard]]<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> and at least one member stood 1.4 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="DB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Like the petty criminal Magaloof, many found their way to Coruscant, where an Almakian apple pie dish has made its way onto the menu at Dex's Diner.|An entry on Leffingites in an artist's journal restored and expanded by the Graf Archive|<ref name="Alien Archive" />}}
[[File:Magaloof_DB.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Magaloof sits in the domed cockpit of a speeder with the Corsucant skyline visible behind him.|The Leffingite Magaloof worked as a speeder thief on Coruscant.]]
The Leffingite [[homeworld]] was [[Almak]],<ref name=" Alien Archive" /> an astronomical object located in the [[Almak system]] of the [[Almak sector]] in the [[Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}}</ref> During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the species came under attack by the government, and many were forced to flee Almak. A large number of Leffingites then found their way to [[Coruscant]],<ref name="Alien Archive" /> the [[capital]] of the Empire in the [[Core Worlds]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref>

An entry on Leffingites, including an image of a Leffingite in red [[Clothing|robes]], was included in an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], which was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="Alien Archive" /> at some point no earlier than [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref>

==Leffingites in the galaxy==
{{Quote|What the?!|Magaloof|audio=Magaloof.flac|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
The Leffingite [[Gender|male]] Magaloof was [[Reproduction|born]] on Almak but had journeyed to Coruscant<ref name="DB" /> by [[22 BBY]]. That [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> he was working as a [[speeder]] [[thief]] and was joyriding in a stolen speeder<ref name="DB" /> through one of the world's skylanes when he nearly collided with the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was hanging from the [[assassin droid]] [[ASN-121]], near the [[Bonadan Embassy]].<ref name="Locations">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''</ref> The author of the journal that mentioned Leffingites noted that a Leffingite had directed them to try Almakian desserts, including [[Almakian apple pie]], at the [[Restaurant|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner]] on Coruscant.<ref name="Alien Archive" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The name of Magaloof's species was inspired by Lee Leffingwell, who had recently been elected to the Austin, Texas City Council when this submission was written. For whatever reason, his name stuck in my head and ended up in the entry. I've always wondered if Council Member Leffingwell is aware of his fame.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="NFCL">{{Blog|narbflick|7|Magaloof: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
A Leffingite first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the species was first identified in an entry for Magaloof on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]],<ref name="DB" /> which had been published by [[February 8]], [[2016]].<ref name="DBOldest">{{Databank|magaloof|Magaloof|oldversion=20160208191550}}</ref>

The [[Leffingite/Legends|name]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used by [[Gregory Walker]], writing as "NarbFlick,"<ref name="NFCL" /> as part of the backstory for [[Magaloof/Legends|Magaloof]],<ref name="OldDB">{{DB|character|magaloof|Magaloof}}</ref> submitted through the StarWars.com [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]]". The entry was added to the website's original [[Databank (original)|Databank]] on [[August 12]], [[2005]].<ref name="What's The Story">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20050812.html|text=Hyperspace Presents: What's the Story, Round 1}}</ref> Walker named the species for [[Wikipedia:Lee Leffingwell|Lee Leffingwell]], as the politician's name was stuck in Walker's head following Leffingwell's recent campaign and election to the [[Wikipedia:Austin City Council|Austin, Texas City Council]] in 2005.<ref name="NFCL" />
